title: Motivate yourself and build your discipline Grappler Baki style
summary: A scripted motivational essay using Grappler Baki characters to define discipline as a habit rather than a trait: doing what needs to be done when it needs to be done regardless of circumstances. NH says parents only give a head start, discipline must be practised daily, and it brings lasting fulfilment.
claims: No one is born disciplined; human nature prefers pleasure, warmth and safety over hardship
Parents who instil discipline are a head start, never an excuse for failure or for not trying
Whatever your upbringing, correcting its flaws and toughening yourself up is your responsibility
Pick any goal and let it consume you; the inner fire must be strong enough to balance the cold bite of discipline
Training for one, 10 or 100 days isn't discipline, however hard; discipline is resilience beyond time and intensity
Discipline is doing what needs to be done when it needs to be done, regardless of circumstances or excuses
Being disciplined is a habit, not a personality trait, so anyone can develop it
The Baki characters inspire because they train regardless of a bad day, a beating, weather, TV or friends
The only way to build discipline is to train; willpower grows only when put into action
Nothing gives more lasting fulfilment than giving yourself fully every day to the craft you love
Discipline is rented, not owned, and rent is due every day
People who quit after reaching a goal never developed true discipline
Discipline becomes self-sufficient and spreads to every other area of life
